# TaxSathi — AI-Powered GST & ITR Assistant for Indian CAs and SMBs

> TaxSathi is a SaaS product that helps Indian Chartered Accountants (CAs) manage client GST and ITR queries 24/7 using AI. CAs get a unique share link and QR code to give clients — clients can ask GST/ITR questions in Gujarati, Hindi, or English without calling the CA directly.

## Product

- Live at: https://taxsathi.online
- CA Dashboard: https://taxsathi.online/dashboard
- Login: https://taxsathi.online/login

## What TaxSathi Does

- AI-powered GST & ITR question answering in Gujarati, Hindi, and English
- CA practice management SaaS for Indian Chartered Accountants
- Unique public chat link per CA (e.g. taxsathi.online/ca/[slug])
- Client-facing 24/7 assistant so CAs stop getting repeated calls
- Automates common queries: GST filing, ITR deadlines, invoice rules, TDS, etc.

## Target Users

- Chartered Accountants (CAs) in India
- Indian SMBs needing GST/ITR guidance
- Freelancers and small business owners filing taxes in India

## Pricing Plans

- Free Trial: 7 days, no credit card required
- Starter: ₹1,999/month
- Pro: ₹3,999/month

## Tech Stack

- Frontend: React (JSX), deployed on Vercel
- Backend/Database: Supabase
- AI: DeepSeek API for GST assistant
- Languages supported: Gujarati, Hindi, English
